import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXCOMP = 500;
    static final int MAXPERS = MAXCOMP;
    static int ncomp, npers, MOD;
    static int[][] choose = new int[MAXCOMP + 1][MAXCOMP + 1];

    static class Res {
        int ways, summaddness;
        Res() {}
        Res(int ways, int summaddness) {
            this.ways = ways;
            this.summaddness = summaddness;
        }
    }

    static boolean[] done2 = new boolean[MAXCOMP + 1];
    static Res[] mem2 = new Res[MAXCOMP + 1];

    static boolean[][] done1 = new boolean[MAXCOMP][MAXPERS + 1];
    static Res[][] mem1 = new Res[MAXCOMP][MAXPERS + 1];

    static long calcsum(int l, int r) {
        return (long)(l + r) * (r - l + 1) / 2;
    }

    static Res go2(int n) {
        if (n == 1) return new Res(2, 0);
        if (done2[n]) return mem2[n];
        Res ret = new Res(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int lcnt = i;
            int rcnt = n - i - 1;
            Res lres = (lcnt == 0) ? new Res(1, 0) : go2(lcnt);
            Res rres = (rcnt == 0) ? new Res(1, 0) : go2(rcnt);
            int mways = (lcnt + 1) + (rcnt + 1);
            long msummaddness = calcsum(0, lcnt) + calcsum(0, rcnt);
            int mlt = choose[lcnt + rcnt][lcnt];
            ret.ways = (int)((ret.ways + (long)lres.ways * mways % MOD * rres.ways % MOD * mlt) % MOD);
            ret.summaddness = (int)((ret.summaddness + (long)lres.summaddness * mways % MOD * rres.ways % MOD * mlt
                    + (long)lres.ways * msummaddness % MOD * rres.ways % MOD * mlt
                    + (long)lres.ways * mways % MOD * rres.summaddness % MOD * mlt) % MOD);
        }
        done2[n] = true;
        mem2[n] = ret;
        return ret;
    }

    static Res go1(int at, int cnt) {
        if (ncomp - at == cnt) return go2(cnt);
        if (done1[at][cnt]) return mem1[at][cnt];
        Res ret = new Res(0, 0);
        for (int i = at; i < ncomp; i++) {
            int lcnt = i - at;
            int rcnt = cnt - lcnt;
            if (rcnt < 0 || rcnt > ncomp - i - 1) continue;
            Res lres = (i == at) ? new Res(1, 0) : go2(lcnt);
            Res rres = (i + 1 == ncomp) ? new Res(1, 0) : go1(i + 1, rcnt);
            int mlt = choose[lcnt + rcnt][lcnt];
            ret.ways = (int)((ret.ways + (long)lres.ways * rres.ways % MOD * mlt) % MOD);
            ret.summaddness = (int)((ret.summaddness + (long)lres.summaddness * rres.ways % MOD * mlt
                    + (long)lres.ways * rres.summaddness % MOD * mlt) % MOD);
        }
        done1[at][cnt] = true;
        mem1[at][cnt] = ret;
        return ret;
    }

    static int solve() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; i++) {
            choose[i][0] = 1;
            choose[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                choose[i][j] = (choose[i - 1][j - 1] + choose[i - 1][j]) % MOD;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= ncomp; i++) {
            done2[i] = false;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < ncomp; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= npers; j++) {
                done1[i][j] = false;
            }
        }
        return go1(0, npers).summaddness;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        ncomp = sc.nextInt();
        npers = sc.nextInt();
        MOD = sc.nextInt();
        System.out.println(solve());
        sc.close();
    }
}
